language.title: Language
language.hint: The language this harness speaks — written to config.edn, and the same one the model is told to answer in. The harness's own sentences (tool results, errors) are not translated.

security.title: Sensitive paths
security.hint: Paths this home calls sensitive — cloud and infrastructure credentials, key material, container and package-manager credentials. A file tool aimed at one of them (read, write, edit, glob, grep) parks for your approval, even inside the project. They live in config.edn's :security: what is listed here is the whole rule, and an empty list says this home guards nothing.
security.fromConfig: This list is this home's own (config.edn's :security :sensitive-paths).
security.fromDefault: These are the built-in paths — this home has written none of its own.
security.empty: This home guards no path: the built-in list is off.

panel.errorNote: A configuration that cannot be resolved is shown instead of the values — the files are still yours to fix.

form.providerIdEditingHint: Renaming means removing this entry and adding another: the id is what the request names and what the credential in .env is derived from.

form.apiKeyEditingHint: Leave empty to keep the line in .env as it is. A value replaces it.
form.apiKeyHint: Written to the home's .env as its own line, named after the id. Never sent back to this page.
form.firstTail: model is this vendor's own default — what a run lands on when no tier names one. Which model a session actually starts on is set in General, not here.
form.noModels: A vendor must declare at least one model: an entry with no models cannot be selected, so offering it would be offering a refusal.
form.fetchNoAddress: Fill in an API address first
form.fetchTitle: Ask the vendor what it serves
form.offeredHint: Tick what you want in the catalog. Each arrives declaring text only — raise it if the vendor takes images.
form.errorNote: Nothing was written — config.edn is exactly as it was.
form.removeTitle: Takes this entry out of config.edn. config.edn.bak holds the file as it was, and the .env line stays.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.builtinNote: A built-in comes from the code, so it cannot be removed. Saving here writes an override with its name to {{file}}.
subagents.fileNote: That file is rewritten whole when this form saves, and what it held before is kept beside it.
subagents.name: Name
subagents.nameHint: How the main agent asks for it. Letters, digits and dashes.
subagents.editingNameHint: The name is what the main agent asks for, so renaming means adding another and removing this one.
subagents.descriptionHint: The main agent reads this when it decides who to hand work to: say what it is good at, and when it is the right one.
subagents.baselineHint: A range is a baseline plus exclusions. There is no field that puts a tool back: eval and the delegating tool are never served to any subagent.
subagents.excludeHint: Comma-separated tool names. In force on the next delegation — nothing restarts.
subagents.removeTitle: Takes this entry out of config.edn's :session. What the file held before is kept beside it.
subagents.errorNote: Nothing was written — config.edn's :session is exactly as it was.
subagents.problemLead: config.edn's :session :subagents block says something that could not be honoured:
subagents.problemTail: The built-ins are still what this session uses.

groups.title: Session behaviour
groups.intro: How a session runs — which file-editing implementation it gets, when it compacts, how long a silent model call may sit, what the fence frees, which skills and instructions it reads. The default group serves every model; a group names the models it serves and overrides the default group, key by key. Which group a session gets follows the model it runs on, resolved by the server.
groups.defaultHint: config.edn's own :session. Edit the six blocks directly — every model is served by them unless a group below says otherwise; a :skills / :instructions list left empty keeps the built-in one.
groups.groupsHint: Each group names the models it serves and overrides the default group. A block a group leaves off keeps the default group's value.
groups.empty: No groups yet — every model is served by the default group.
groups.removeTitle: Remove this group? Its models fall back to the default group.
groups.name: Name
groups.nameHintNew: What this group is called in the list — a non-empty, unique string.
groups.nameHintEdit: The name is only a label; the file is rewritten whole on save.
groups.modelsHint: Select one or more. A group with no model cannot match a session, and is refused.
groups.modelsNone: No models in the catalog yet — add a provider on the Models page first.
groups.errorNote: Nothing was written — config.edn's :session is exactly as it was.

block.editingDefault: Every model edits files this way, unless a group below says otherwise.
block.editingGroup: On: this group's models edit files this way. Off: the default group's editing stands.
block.compactionDefault: Every model compacts by these numbers, unless a group below says otherwise.
block.compactionGroup: On: this group's models compact this way. Off: the default group's ratios stand.
block.llmDefault: Every model is guarded by these timeouts, unless a group below says otherwise.
block.llmGroup: On: this group's models are guarded this way. Off: the default group's timeouts stand.
block.approvalDefault: Every model gets this fence, unless a group below says otherwise. An empty fence and no fence are the same fence, so leave it empty to add nothing.
block.approvalGroup: On: this group's models get this fence. Off: the default group's fence stands.
block.skillsDefault: Every model reads these roots; leave it empty to use the built-in ones.
block.skillsGroup: On: this group's models read these roots. Off: the default group's roots stand.
block.instructionsDefault: Every model reads these files; leave it empty to use the built-in AGENTS.md.
block.instructionsGroup: On: this group's models read these files. Off: the default group's files stand.

sessions.title: Conversations
sessions.hint: Every conversation this home keeps, in one list. Tick the ones you mean, then archive, unarchive or delete them in one go; a row the server refused says why underneath it.
sessions.deleteRunning: A conversation here is still running — delete it once it settles.
sessions.empty: This home has no conversations yet.
sessions.deleteBody: Deleting takes a conversation out of this home for good: its record (the jsonl file), its anchors, its todos and its claim all go with it. Archiving would only have hidden it.
